policy: East Asian tea vessels only. Tea spoons, tea scoops, ladles, and spoon-like tools are excluded from new additions. Each item needs a unique accession, source record, source image, verified image rights, and visually reviewed transparent cutout.
imageProcess: Local BiRefNet Lite CPU segmentation; source RGB retained before 1200x1200 resizing; 10% margin; lossless-alpha WebP. Every exported cutout was compared to its source on black and white.
